The '''Wood Mallet''' is a [[Weapons#Club|club weapon]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|2000}} after reaching floor 40 in [[The Mines]].  It may also be obtained by [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|breaking boxes and barrels]], or as a [[The Mines#Special Items|special monster drop]], on floors 40-59 in [[The Mines]]. It is a possible reward for the chest on floor 60 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Level raised from 2 to 3 and sell price raised from {{Price|100}} to {{Price|150}}. Added as a possible reward on floor 60 in the remixed Mines.}}
